WAYLINE PRINCIPLES — Public Curriculum Edition

The Wayline style reads the space between fighters as a route, not a line. Distance, timing, and angle are resources to be managed, not obstacles to overcome.

Foundation: The practitioner moves first. Response follows the route already established, not the opponent's last action.

Principle of Adaptive Distance: Maintain the range where your blade works and theirs doesn't. When the route closes, change it.

Principle of Committed Exchange: Enter an exchange only when the route favors your blade. If it doesn't, move. Moving is not retreating.

Principle of Route-Reading: Every opponent reveals their next route before they take it. Watch the feet, not the blade.

Advanced material restricted by the Corsair Swordsmanship Branch. Seek instruction at an authorized school.

Republic civic reference.name: Republic civic reference
Republic civic reference.description: A compact reference guide to Starian Republic civic structure, laws, and citizen rights. Covers the Capitol Accord, civic dispute resolution, inter-house legal standing, and basic information about each Great House's governance model. Published by the Public Record Archive in Relstaris. Free at most government offices; purchased copies are available at booksellers. [ Basic | Common | Public Record Archive, Relstaris ]
Republic civic reference.mediaContent:
THE STARIAN REPUBLIC — A Citizen's Reference

Published by the Public Record Archive, Relstaris.

THE CAPITOL ACCORD establishes Relstaris as neutral ground. No single Great House may claim territorial sovereignty within city limits. Every citizen enjoys baseline rights regardless of house affiliation, species, or origin.

YOUR RIGHTS: Free movement through the Grand Lunar Gate Hub. Access to Capitol Service employment. Equal standing before the Arbitration Court. Medical care at Myralis Capitol Clinic (subsidized for citizens).

THE GREAT HOUSES: Castro (education, Solvraxis), Genesis (research, Korrvane), Contair (engineering, Vexorath), Corsair (trade, Helvyra), Volen (industry, Ignivex), Dravon (military, Quilrath — currently under separate authority).

DISPUTES: File through the Arbitration Court in the Public Protection District. Inter-house matters may be escalated to the rotating council in High Relstaris.

This guide does not constitute legal advice.

Frontier customs guide.name: Frontier customs guide
Frontier customs guide.description: A hand-copied pamphlet circulating in Dustfall that lists the settlement's thirteen unwritten customs. No official publisher — the text is passed between newcomers as an informal orientation. Some copies include personal annotations from previous owners. The customs are not law; they are enforced through social pressure and reputation. [ Frontier | Common | Dustfall ]
Frontier customs guide.mediaContent:
DUSTFALL CUSTOMS — Hand to the next new face

1. Honor your debts.
2. Don't steal from those who share.
3. Defend your neighbors without being asked.
4. Mind your own business unless invited in.
5. The first claim stands.
6. A handshake is a contract.
7. Don't bring house politics to the frontier.
8. Everyone works or everyone knows.
9. The gate is for everyone.
10. Water is never wasted.
11. Strangers get one meal free.
12. What happens in the dust stays in the dust.
13. Never cross the Last Line Company.

Nobody wrote these down first. They wrote themselves. Break one and see how fast the dust remembers.

Quilrath access card — visitor.name: Quilrath access card — visitor
Quilrath access card — visitor.description: An issued visitor-grade access credential for Quilrath, granting Level 1 access and Grade 3 civic standing. Permits movement in designated public areas of the Gray Rings only. All movements are logged. The card must be carried at all times within Quilrath; failure to present it on request results in immediate detention. Issued at Quilrath's entry checkpoint and must be returned on departure. [ Basic | Restricted | Quilrath entry checkpoint ]
Quilrath access card — visitor.mediaContent:
QUILRATH VISITOR CREDENTIAL

ACCESS LEVEL: 1
CIVIC STANDING: 3 (Probationary)
VALID ZONES: Gray Ring public areas only

CONDITIONS OF ENTRY:
- Carry this credential at all times
- Present on request to any authorized official
- Do not enter restricted zones
- Do not photograph or record government facilities
- Report to exit checkpoint before credential expiry

FAILURE TO COMPLY RESULTS IN DETENTION AND CREDENTIAL REVOCATION.

Issued under the authority of the Balrath Administrative Complex.

Yalven weapon modification.name: Yalven weapon modification
Yalven weapon modification.description: A premium weapon modification produced by House Yalven's Forgeworks in Helvyra. Yalven modifications are precision-engineered to improve a specific weapon's performance characteristic — balance, heat dissipation, grip geometry, or firing mechanism. Each modification is fitted to a specific weapon and cannot be transferred casually. Yalven inspection seals appear on the modification's housing. Cost reflects the specialist labor; Yalven does not produce cheap work. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Truehand ]

Bolt n Break frontier mod.name: Bolt n Break frontier mod
Bolt n Break frontier mod.description: A weapon modification from Korrik Caelthorn's 'Bolt n Break' workshop on Dustfall's Refit Row. Frontier modifications that 'work brilliantly until they do not.' Performance may exceed factory specification in specific conditions but carries inherent risk. No warranty, no return policy, no manufacturer's support. Test at the Test-Fire Barrier before live use. If it starts making a sound it didn't make before, stop using it. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Contair-compatible replacement parts.name: Contair-compatible replacement parts
Contair-compatible replacement parts.description: Replacement components manufactured to Contair specifications — or claiming to be. Legitimate parts carry Contair verification stamps; counterfeit versions circulate widely, especially on the frontier. A counterfeit part may function adequately or fail at the worst moment. The Vexorath Verification Desk at Relstaris Grand Market confirms legitimate standards. Dustfall's Dravon Component Bin sells openly acknowledged inferior alternatives at lower cost. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Vexorath Verification Desk ]

Varriko witness seal.name: Varriko witness seal
Varriko witness seal.description: A certification document bearing House Varriko's silver ledger seal crossed by two balance-lines. Varriko Witness Seals authenticate contracts, verify identities, and certify transactions. The seal is recognized across Nexara as a reliable third-party verification. Obtaining a false Varriko seal is possible but extremely risky — House Varriko's Trade Audit Room investigates irregularities aggressively. [ Standard | Named-maker | House Varriko, Helvyra ]
Varriko witness seal.mediaContent:
VARRIKO WITNESS SEAL — AUTHENTICATED DOCUMENT

This seal certifies that the attached document or transaction has been witnessed and verified by a licensed Varriko assessor.

Seal number: [UNIQUE]
Issuing office: Varriko Witness Seal Office, Helvyra

Tampering with, forging, or misrepresenting a Varriko seal constitutes fraud under Republic commercial law and is subject to prosecution through the Arbitration Court.

Verification: Present at any Varriko Trade Office for confirmation.

Dravon-manufactured utility gear.name: Dravon-manufactured utility gear
Dravon-manufactured utility gear.description: Standard-issue utility equipment manufactured in Quilrath under Dravon's state production system. Functional but widely regarded as inferior to Contair standards — adequate materials, acceptable tolerances, predictable performance without distinction. Available at Quilrath Equipment Row in the Relstaris Grand Market, where it sells on price and availability rather than quality. Frontier settlements use it when nothing better is available. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Salvaged drone components.name: Salvaged drone components
Salvaged drone components.description: Recovered components from decommissioned, damaged, or abandoned drones — sensors, actuators, power cells, and structural elements. Original manufacture varies; identification requires technical knowledge. Value depends on condition, compatibility, and what the buyer needs. Common trade goods in Dustfall's Bone Yard and the Vein Market. Military-grade components carry legal restrictions in Republic territory. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Bone Yard, Dustfall ]

Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.name: Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers
Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.description:
Xelaphis — Deep-City Layers.

Insulated, moisture-wicking layers designed for the constant cool humidity of Xelaphis's subterranean environment. Fabrics reflect bioluminescent light for visibility in low-light corridors. Cut allows freedom of movement in the three-dimensional architecture where climbing and ducking are routine. Surface-dweller clothing tends to be uncomfortable underground; deep-city layers solve the temperature and moisture problems. [ Standard | Uncommon | Xelaphis ]

Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.name: Nexara — Fieldwork Layers
Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.description:
Nexara — Fieldwork Layers.

Durable, practical clothing designed for outdoor work, field research, and sustained activity in varied terrain. Reinforced at stress points, fitted with utility pockets, and compatible with protective gear. Not fashion — function. These are what contractors, field researchers, and frontier workers wear when the job matters more than the look. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Nexara — Medical Professional.name: Nexara — Medical Professional
Nexara — Medical Professional.description:
Nexara — Medical Professional.

Clean, fitted clinical clothing suitable for healthcare environments. Antimicrobial treatment, fluid-resistant outer layer, and identifiable coloring per facility standards. Myralis clinic staff wear standardized versions; independent practitioners choose their own within professional norms. The clothing signals competence and hygiene before the wearer speaks. [ Standard | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Dravon discipline blade.name: Dravon discipline blade
Dravon discipline blade.description: A sword forged to Dravon defensive specifications — weighted for parrying, with a wide guard and a blade geometry that rewards patience over aggression. Supplied through Dravon garrison channels. [ Standard | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Castro restraint blade.name: Castro restraint blade
Castro restraint blade.description: A sword designed for the Castro and Valcoro restraint tradition — shorter blade, weighted pommel, and a guard that facilitates controlled holds. Purpose-built for subduing rather than killing. [ Standard | Named-maker | House Castro ]

Frontier salvage blade.name: Frontier salvage blade
Frontier salvage blade.description: A serviceable sword assembled from salvaged alloy stock in a Dustfall workshop. No house mark, no pedigree, but the edge holds and the balance works for anyone who can swing it. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

House-forged blade.name: House-forged blade
House-forged blade.description: A sword produced by a recognised house forge to inherited specifications — consistent metallurgy, fitted grip, and a maker's mark that means something in the right circles. A step above frontier work. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Masterwork blade.name: Masterwork blade
Masterwork blade.description: An exceptional sword produced by a master-rated smith — balance, edge geometry, and material quality at the practical ceiling of the craft. The kind of weapon that outlasts its owner. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Standard issue sidearm.name: Standard issue sidearm
Standard issue sidearm.description: A basic plasma sidearm common to security details, civic patrols, and issued positions across Nexara. Reliable, underpowered, and designed for deterrence over sustained firefights. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Basic | Restricted | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Frontier scatter-gun.name: Frontier scatter-gun
Frontier scatter-gun.description: A wide-bore plasma weapon common in Dustfall and frontier settlements. Short range, heavy spread, devastating in confined spaces. Maintenance is forgiving; accuracy is not. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Corsair quickdraw piece.name: Corsair quickdraw piece
Corsair quickdraw piece.description: A compact plasma sidearm modified for the Corsair emphasis on movement — reduced draw weight, shortened barrel, and a grip profile that clears a holster fast. Accuracy trades for speed. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Standard | Named-maker | Corsair Cache, Korrvane ]

Precision marksman rifle.name: Precision marksman rifle
Precision marksman rifle.description: A long-range plasma rifle built to marksman specifications — stabilised barrel, magnified optics, and a tuned power cell that trades rate of fire for consistent long-distance impact. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Genesis heavy pistol.name: Genesis heavy pistol
Genesis heavy pistol.description: A high-output sidearm from the Genesis and Orvantis tradition — built heavier, kicks harder, and puts more energy into each shot than standard sidearms. Wrist strength is not optional. Damage type: energy (wounds Starians). [ Reinforced | Named-maker | House Genesis ]

Masterwork precision rifle.name: Masterwork precision rifle
Masterwork precision rifle.description: An exceptional long-range weapon produced to the highest manufacturing standard available on Nexara. Every component is fitted, tuned, and tested to tolerances that mass production cannot match. Damage type: energy (wounds Starians). [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Training staff.name: Training staff
Training staff.description: A weighted practice staff padded at both ends for supervised training. Impact is dulled, weight is educational, and the design ensures nobody gets seriously hurt while learning the basics. [ Training | Common | Academy issue ]

Reinforced combat staff.name: Reinforced combat staff
Reinforced combat staff.description: A hardened alloy staff built for actual combat — weighted for striking, balanced for blocking, and strong enough to take the kind of abuse a wooden staff would not survive. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Channeling staff.name: Channeling staff
Channeling staff.description: A staff constructed with resonance-compatible materials that facilitate channeled magical workings. The combat weight is modest; the value is in the material, not the impact. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ironwood quarterstaff.name: Ironwood quarterstaff
Ironwood quarterstaff.description: A dense ironwood staff harvested and cured in the traditional manner. Heavy, resilient, and well-suited to defensive staff work where absorbing force matters more than speed. [ Reinforced | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Masterwork resonant staff.name: Masterwork resonant staff
Masterwork resonant staff.description: An exceptional staff constructed from layered resonance-compatible alloys by a specialist fabricator. Carries impact effectively and supports channeled work without degradation. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Utility knife.name: Utility knife
Utility knife.description: A common-pattern folding knife carried by most frontier residents as a tool first and a weapon second. Adequate for cutting tasks; limited in a dedicated fight. [ Basic | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Belt knife.name: Belt knife
Belt knife.description: A fixed-blade personal knife worn at the waist — common throughout Nexara as everyday carry. Better balanced for defensive use than a utility folder but still a secondary weapon. [ Basic | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Fighting knife.name: Fighting knife
Fighting knife.description: A purpose-built combat knife with a guard, a committed edge, and a grip designed for retention under pressure. Not a tool; a weapon carried with intent. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Frontier skinning blade.name: Frontier skinning blade
Frontier skinning blade.description: A wide-bellied knife designed for field work — skinning, dressing, and material processing. Effective in a fight at close range, but the edge profile favours slicing over thrusting. [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Masterwork combat knife.name: Masterwork combat knife
Masterwork combat knife.description: An exceptional fighting knife from a specialist bladesmith — perfect edge geometry, fitted grip, and a balance that makes the blade feel like an extension of the hand. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Work mallet.name: Work mallet
Work mallet.description: A heavy-headed mallet used in construction, metalwork, and demolition. Effective as a weapon in the way that any heavy tool is — crude but undeniable. [ Basic | Common | Red Forges, Ignivex ]

Weighted baton.name: Weighted baton
Weighted baton.description: A balanced striking baton carried by civic security and authorised enforcement personnel. Designed for controlled force application — deterrence and compliance, not lethal combat. [ Standard | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Frontier hammer.name: Frontier hammer
Frontier hammer.description: A heavy-headed hammer common among frontier workers and settlers who need a tool that doubles as personal protection. Simple, durable, and effective at close range. [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Masterwork warhammer.name: Masterwork warhammer
Masterwork warhammer.description: An exceptional combat hammer forged to inherited martial specifications — balance, head geometry, and shaft construction all optimised for delivering maximum impact with control. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Red Forges, Ignivex ]

Balanced throwing knives.name: Balanced throwing knives
Balanced throwing knives.description: A matched set of purpose-weighted throwing knives in a belt carrier. Factory-balanced to spin consistently at standard combat distances. Finite supply; retrieval is the user's problem. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Frontier throwing tools.name: Frontier throwing tools
Frontier throwing tools.description: Weighted objects — bolts, slugs, and shaped scrap — selected and carried specifically for throwing. Common among frontier residents who cannot afford dedicated weapons. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

Masterwork throwing set.name: Masterwork throwing set
Masterwork throwing set.description: An exceptional set of precision-balanced throwing implements from a specialist fabricator — consistent weight, predictable flight, and fitted carrying harness. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Practice bow.name: Practice bow
Practice bow.description: A low-draw training bow used in recreational and introductory archery. Safe enough for supervised practice, underpowered for hunting or combat. [ Training | Common | Academy issue ]

Hunting bow.name: Hunting bow
Hunting bow.description: A practical field bow with sufficient draw weight for game and moderate range. Common among frontier hunters and rural communities where ammunition supply is unreliable. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Composite field bow.name: Composite field bow
Composite field bow.description: A layered composite bow built for field use — higher draw weight, better performance in variable weather, and effective at ranges that simple bows cannot reach. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Helvyra supplier ]

Masterwork longbow.name: Masterwork longbow
Masterwork longbow.description: An exceptional longbow crafted by a specialist bowyer — optimal draw, consistent release, and material quality that translates every grain of the archer's strength into range and impact. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Standard impact gloves.name: Standard impact gloves
Standard impact gloves.description: Reinforced gloves with powered impact amplification — a basic augmentation common in industrial and security applications. The gloves increase striking force within the frame's rated capacity. [ Basic | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Reinforced strike gloves.name: Reinforced strike gloves
Reinforced strike gloves.description: Combat-rated powered gloves with improved force amplification and impact distribution. A step above industrial standard; designed for sustained close-quarters use. [ Standard | Common | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Contair precision gauntlets.name: Contair precision gauntlets
Contair precision gauntlets.description: Assisted combat gloves manufactured to Contair engineering standards — precise force scaling, responsive activation, and diagnostics that report remaining charge and component wear. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Masterwork power gauntlets.name: Masterwork power gauntlets
Masterwork power gauntlets.description: Exceptional powered gauntlets built to the highest available specification — maximum force amplification, reinforced knuckle geometry, and a power system that sustains peak output longer than standard models. [ Masterwork | Restricted | Vexorath Exchange ]

Grip wraps.name: Grip wraps
Grip wraps.description: Padded hand wraps with textured grip surfaces designed for grappling — improved purchase on fabric, skin, and armor without the rigidity of gloves. Common in training halls and tournaments. [ Basic | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Reinforced fighting wraps.name: Reinforced fighting wraps
Reinforced fighting wraps.description: Combat-grade hand and wrist wraps with impact padding and reinforced knuckle coverage. Protect the hands during strikes while maintaining the grip flexibility grappling demands. [ Basic | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Masterwork combat bindings.name: Masterwork combat bindings
Masterwork combat bindings.description: Exceptional hand, wrist, and forearm bindings constructed from layered advanced textiles. Combine striking protection, grappling grip, and joint support in a single integrated wrap system. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Starian aerial lance.name: Starian aerial lance
Starian aerial lance.description: A lightweight lance designed for Starian aerial combat — weighted for stability in flight, with a grip that accommodates aerial angles and a shaft that survives impact at flight speed. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Elyri resonant blade.name: Elyri resonant blade
Elyri resonant blade.description: A blade forged from resonance-compatible alloys that respond to embodied field contact. The weapon’s cutting properties are real and physical; the resonance enhances the wielder’s field connection, not the edge. [ Standard | Uncommon | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Affinity focus rod.name: Affinity focus rod
Affinity focus rod.description: A compact rod constructed from field-compatible materials used by Starian affinity practitioners as a focus point for controlled expression. The rod concentrates attention, not power. [ Standard | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Ceremonial blade.name: Ceremonial blade
Ceremonial blade.description: A presentation-quality sword carried for ceremony, diplomatic occasions, and formal house business. The metalwork and finish are exceptional; the combat utility is secondary to the statement. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Padded cap.name: Padded cap
Padded cap.description: A basic head covering with light impact padding. Minimal protection against incidental contact; not rated for combat. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard helmet.name: Standard helmet
Standard helmet.description: A fitted protective helmet meeting baseline security and industrial specifications. Adequate impact and penetration resistance for standard threat levels. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Frontier salvage helm.name: Frontier salvage helm
Frontier salvage helm.description: A repaired and refitted helmet assembled from salvaged military components in a Dustfall workshop. Open-face design preserves visibility at the cost of coverage. [ Frontier | Common | Refit Row salvage ]

House-forged helm.name: House-forged helm
House-forged helm.description: A protective helmet manufactured to house garrison specifications — impact-rated liner, reinforced shell, and a profile that identifies the wearer’s affiliation at a glance. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Patrol helmet.name: Patrol helmet
Patrol helmet.description: A security-grade helmet with integrated communication mounts and a wide visor. Standard issue for civic patrol and perimeter security across Nexara. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Combat visor.name: Combat visor
Combat visor.description: A tactical half-helmet with an articulated visor and built-in threat indicators. Favoured by combat professionals who prioritise situational awareness over maximum head coverage. [ Standard | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Starian flight visor.name: Starian flight visor
Starian flight visor.description: An aerodynamic half-helm designed for Starian aerial use — minimal drag, wind deflection, and eye protection at flight speed without restricting the peripheral vision flight demands. [ Standard | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Kharai sensory helm.name: Kharai sensory helm
Kharai sensory helm.description: A protective helmet designed for Kharai biology — open-ear construction that preserves auditory discrimination, with scent channels that avoid filtering the information Kharai hearing and scenting depend on. [ Standard | Uncommon | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Light work tunic.name: Light work tunic
Light work tunic.description: A reinforced tunic with modest torso protection for general work and light security duties. Comfortable enough for a full shift; protective enough to matter in an incident. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard patrol vest.name: Standard patrol vest
Standard patrol vest.description: A torso protector meeting patrol security specifications — rated for common threat levels, fitted for movement, and compatible with standard harness attachments. [ Standard | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Dravon defense plate.name: Dravon defense plate
Dravon defense plate.description: Heavy body armor manufactured to Dravon garrison standards — maximum protection, minimal concession to mobility. Built for holding a position, not chasing targets. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Corsair mobile armor.name: Corsair mobile armor
Corsair mobile armor.description: Torso armor designed for the Corsair emphasis on movement — segmented construction, reduced weight, and articulation points that preserve the full range of motion combat footwork demands. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Corsair Cache, Korrvane ]

Masterwork body plate.name: Masterwork body plate
Masterwork body plate.description: Exceptional body armor produced to the highest available specification — layered construction, fitted articulation, and material quality that provides maximum protection without unnecessary weight. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

House-forged cuirass.name: House-forged cuirass
House-forged cuirass.description: A torso plate manufactured by a recognised house forge to inherited specifications. Heavy, reliable, and marked with the forge’s stamp. [ Reinforced | Named-maker | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Olyth adaptive vest.name: Olyth adaptive vest
Olyth adaptive vest.description: A flexible torso protector designed for Olyth reshaping — segmented panels with controlled expansion joints that accommodate body restructuring without binding or detaching. [ Standard | Uncommon | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Rivani fitted armor.name: Rivani fitted armor
Rivani fitted armor.description: Body armor scaled and fitted for Rivani proportions — accurate sizing, appropriate articulation, and coverage geometry that accounts for the actual body rather than forcing a standard-scale design. [ Standard | Uncommon | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Affinity training vest.name: Affinity training vest
Affinity training vest.description: A torso protector constructed from field-compatible materials that avoid interfering with controlled affinity expression. Modest armour; the value is in what it does not block. [ Training | Uncommon | Academy issue ]

Channeling robes.name: Channeling robes
Channeling robes.description: Layered robes cut from resonance-compatible textiles used by magic practitioners during sustained channeling work. Physical protection is minimal; the material supports the working. [ Basic | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Scout's armor.name: Scout's armor
Scout's armor.description: Lightweight torso armor designed for reconnaissance and covert movement — reduced noise, muted finish, and a profile that avoids catching light or snagging on obstacles. [ Standard | Uncommon | Grit and Supply ]

Medic's vest.name: Medic's vest
Medic's vest.description: A torso protector with integrated quick-access pouches, tool loops, and a layout designed for field medical response. The armor is standard; the configuration saves time. [ Standard | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Protective trousers.name: Protective trousers
Protective trousers.description: Reinforced trousers with knee and shin padding for general work and light physical activity. Basic lower-body protection against scrapes, impacts, and minor hazards. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard leg guards.name: Standard leg guards
Standard leg guards.description: Fitted shin and knee protection meeting baseline security specifications. Adequate for patrol duty and supported enforcement work. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Reinforced leg plates.name: Reinforced leg plates
Reinforced leg plates.description: Heavy lower-body armor with articulated knee joints and rigid shin plates. Combat-rated protection for front-line security and garrison duty. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Mobile leg armor.name: Mobile leg armor
Mobile leg armor.description: Lightweight leg protection designed for mobile combat — flexible panels, low-profile knee guards, and a fit that preserves running stride and lateral movement. [ Reinforced | Common | Corsair Cache, Korrvane ]

Masterwork greaves.name: Masterwork greaves
Masterwork greaves.description: Exceptional lower-body armor produced to specialist specifications — maximum protection with articulation that preserves natural movement. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Starian flight leggings.name: Starian flight leggings
Starian flight leggings.description: Streamlined leg armor designed for Starian aerial use — aerodynamic profile, secured panels that resist wind displacement, and articulation that accommodates airborne body positions. [ Standard | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Stealth leg wraps.name: Stealth leg wraps
Stealth leg wraps.description: Lightweight leg coverings with sound-dampening construction. Minimal physical protection; maximum noise reduction for covert movement. [ Basic | Uncommon | Grit and Supply ]

Padded sandals.name: Padded sandals
Padded sandals.description: Basic open footwear with reinforced sole padding. Minimal foot protection for indoor, training, and residential use. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Standard boots.name: Standard boots
Standard boots.description: General-purpose protective footwear with reinforced toe, ankle support, and a sole rated for mixed terrain. Adequate for most duties short of combat. [ Standard | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Reinforced combat boots.name: Reinforced combat boots
Reinforced combat boots.description: Combat-rated footwear with armoured toe and heel, ankle stabilisation, and a sole designed for rapid movement on hard surfaces. [ Reinforced | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Frontier tread boots.name: Frontier tread boots
Frontier tread boots.description: Heavy-duty footwear built for rough frontier terrain — deep tread, waterproof construction, and ankle support that handles uneven ground, loose material, and long distances. [ Frontier | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Masterwork armored boots.name: Masterwork armored boots
Masterwork armored boots.description: Exceptional protective footwear produced to the highest available specification — maximum impact protection, fitted ankle support, and sole construction that handles any surface. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Starian flight boots.name: Starian flight boots
Starian flight boots.description: Lightweight footwear designed for Starian aerial use — streamlined profile, secure fit that handles landing impact, and a sole that grips on the transition from flight to ground. [ Standard | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Scout's boots.name: Scout's boots
Scout's boots.description: Soft-soled footwear with sound-dampening construction for covert approach. Comfort and silence over protection. [ Standard | Uncommon | Grit and Supply ]

Standard gauntlets.name: Standard gauntlets
Standard gauntlets.description: Protective hand coverings meeting security baseline specifications — reinforced knuckles, secured wrist, and enough articulation for weapon handling. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Reinforced combat gauntlets.name: Reinforced combat gauntlets
Reinforced combat gauntlets.description: Combat-rated hand protection with rigid knuckle plates, secured wrist articulation, and palm grip surfaces. Designed for sustained weapon use under combat conditions. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Dravon garrison issue ]

Inscription-compatible gloves.name: Inscription-compatible gloves
Inscription-compatible gloves.description: Lightweight gloves constructed from materials that do not interfere with magical inscription work. The fingertip conductivity preserves the practitioner’s contact with the working surface. [ Basic | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Masterwork armored gauntlets.name: Masterwork armored gauntlets
Masterwork armored gauntlets.description: Exceptional hand protection produced to the highest specification — maximum coverage, fitted articulation, and material quality that survives direct weapon contact. [ Masterwork | Named-maker | Vexorath Exchange ]

Rivani precision gloves.name: Rivani precision gloves
Rivani precision gloves.description: Hand coverings scaled and fitted for Rivani proportions with fingertip sensitivity preserved. The sizing accounts for actual Rivani fine motor control rather than compressing it. [ Basic | Uncommon | Yalven Settled Fit ]

Zencadian interface gloves.name: Zencadian interface gloves
Zencadian interface gloves.description: Technical gloves designed for Zencadian system work — conductive fingertips, compatibility with standard interface surfaces, and protection that does not compromise tactile feedback. [ Basic | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Affinity focus crystal.name: Affinity focus crystal
Affinity focus crystal.description: A palm-sized crystal grown from field-compatible mineral stock, carried by Starian affinity practitioners as a concentration focus. The crystal does not amplify power; it provides a stable reference point for controlled expression. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Resonance anchor.name: Resonance anchor
Resonance anchor.description: A dense resonance-compatible object worn against the skin by Elyri practitioners — stabilises the personal field during intensive embodiment work and provides a recovery baseline during rest. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Vexorath Fabrication Yards ]

Field perception lens.name: Field perception lens
Field perception lens.description: A small optical device treated with field-reactive compounds that makes certain magical and affinity phenomena visible as colour shifts or distortion patterns. Requires training to interpret. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Channeling conduit.name: Channeling conduit
Channeling conduit.description: A wrist-worn device constructed from layered resonance-compatible materials that reduces channeling resistance during sustained magical workings. The conduit degrades with use and requires periodic replacement. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Inscription stylus set.name: Inscription stylus set
Inscription stylus set.description: A matched set of precision inscription implements carried in a fitted case — each stylus calibrated for a different inscription medium and working scale. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Routefall Market ]

Tactical earpiece.name: Tactical earpiece
Tactical earpiece.description: A compact communication and situational awareness device worn in the ear. Filters relevant audio, relays tactical information, and provides directional sound cues in noisy environments. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Combat harness.name: Combat harness
Combat harness.description: A fitted torso harness with load distribution and equipment attachment points. Spreads carried weight effectively and provides anchor points for climbing, rappelling, and emergency extraction. [ Standard | Common | Quilrath Equipment Row ]

Targeting scope.name: Targeting scope
Targeting scope.description: A portable optical magnification device compatible with most Nexaran firearm mounting systems. Improves effective range and target identification at distance. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Yalven Forgeworks ]

Shield bracer.name: Shield bracer
Shield bracer.description: A forearm-mounted rigid panel that provides localized blocking surface for unarmed combatants and light-weapon users. Not a full shield; a point defence for the trained. [ Standard | Common | Fight-Day Market, Korrvane ]

Weighted training bands.name: Weighted training bands
Weighted training bands.description: Adjustable weighted bands worn at the wrists and ankles during training and daily activity. The resistance builds functional strength over time. [ Standard | Common | Korrvane Recovery Yards ]

House signet ring.name: House signet ring
House signet ring.description: A ring bearing the recognised mark of a Nexaran house — a statement of affiliation and standing that opens certain doors and closes others. The significance is social, not magical. [ Standard | Restricted | Issuing House ]

Diplomat's pendant.name: Diplomat's pendant
Diplomat's pendant.description: A pendant worn by individuals engaged in formal inter-house or inter-faction communication. The design signals diplomatic intent and is recognised across most Nexaran political frameworks. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Capitol Accord office, Relstaris ]

Authority badge.name: Authority badge
Authority badge.description: A visible badge of recognised authority — civic, house, or professional — that carries weight in formal interactions. The badge is a credential, not a weapon; misuse has consequences. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Relstaris civic issue ]

Trade medallion.name: Trade medallion
Trade medallion.description: A merchant’s credential recognised across Nexaran markets and trade exchanges. Signals established commercial standing and opens access to wholesale channels and professional rates. [ Reinforced | Restricted | Common Scale, Helvyra ]

Research lens.name: Research lens
Research lens.description: A magnification and analysis device used by researchers, archivists, and inspectors. Improves detail resolution for material examination, document verification, and specimen study. [ Reinforced | Common | Vexorath Exchange ]

Navigation compass.name: Navigation compass
Navigation compass.description: A reliable compass calibrated for Nexara’s magnetic and positioning environment. Provides consistent orientation data where electronic navigation is unavailable or untrustworthy. [ Reinforced | Common | Helvyra supplier ]

Medical scanner.name: Medical scanner
Medical scanner.description: A portable diagnostic device that provides basic vital signs, injury indicators, and treatment guidance. Not a substitute for trained assessment; a supplement to it. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Climbing harness.name: Climbing harness
Climbing harness.description: A fitted harness with attachment points, load distribution, and controlled descent capability for vertical terrain. Essential for serious climbing; helpful for industrial and rescue applications. [ Reinforced | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Stealth cloak.name: Stealth cloak
Stealth cloak.description: A full-length cloak constructed from sound-dampening, low-reflectance textiles. Conceals outline, muffles movement noise, and reduces visual signature in low-light conditions. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Quiet Thread, Dustfall ]

Communication device.name: Communication device
Communication device.description: A portable communication unit compatible with Nexara’s civilian network infrastructure. Voice and text capable within network range; limited to line-of-sight in areas without relay coverage. [ Standard | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Survivor's charm.name: Survivor's charm
Survivor's charm.description: A small personal object — the specific form varies — carried by individuals who have endured something that should have ended them. The charm is a reminder, not a talisman; the resilience is the owner’s. [ Standard | Common | Dustfall ]

Agility anklet.name: Agility anklet
Agility anklet.description: A light weighted anklet designed to improve proprioception and reflexive ankle stabilisation through constant low-level resistance. Worn during training and carried into practice. [ Standard | Common | Korrvane Recovery Yards ]

Scholar's circlet.name: Scholar's circlet
Scholar's circlet.description: A headband worn by scholars and researchers as a practical concentration aid — mild temple pressure that reduces distraction. Also a visible marker of academic commitment. [ Standard | Common | Solvraxis ]

Starian flight harness.name: Starian flight harness
Starian flight harness.description: A torso harness designed specifically for Starian aerial use — load distribution during flight, equipment retention, and emergency recovery attachment points. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Korrvane ]

Kharai scent filter.name: Kharai scent filter
Kharai scent filter.description: A wearable nasal filter that reduces ambient scent noise without blocking the specific chemical signatures Kharai scenting depends on. Improves discrimination in contaminated environments. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Rivani magnification lens.name: Rivani magnification lens
Rivani magnification lens.description: A wearable magnification device scaled for Rivani use that enhances visual resolution for fine manual work. Adjustable focus and worn on a fitted headband. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Olyth stabiliser band.name: Olyth stabiliser band
Olyth stabiliser band.description: A flexible band worn against the core pattern by Olyth individuals during complex reshaping. Provides tactile feedback on structural integrity and core-pattern alignment. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Zencadian interface module.name: Zencadian interface module
Zencadian interface module.description: A compact wrist-mounted computing interface designed for Zencadian technical work. Provides diagnostic readouts, network status, and system interaction tools in a form factor that leaves both hands free. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Acrobatics training harness.name: Acrobatics training harness
Acrobatics training harness.description: A lightweight webbing harness with reinforced attachment points and balance-calibration weights. Designed for solo practice of aerial maneuvers, tumbling sequences, and controlled falls. Adjustable for wingspan and body type. Inspect webbing and load points before each session; frayed sections compromise arrest capability. Not rated for freefall recovery. [ Standard | Common | Korrvane Recovery Yards ]

Animal handling lead set.name: Animal handling lead set
Animal handling lead set.description: Adjustable leads, coupling snaps, and a muzzle-guard fitted for common Nexaran working animals. Rated for standard livestock and trained companions; not suitable for wild predators without additional restraint. Inspect hardware for fatigue cracks after heavy use. [ Standard | Common | Corsair trade goods ]

Biology field sampler.name: Biology field sampler
Biology field sampler.description: A sealed collection kit with sample vials, preservation agents, a hand magnifier, and labeling supplies for biological fieldwork. Supports specimen collection, basic morphological comparison, and chain-of-custody documentation. Analysis beyond visual identification requires laboratory access. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Carpentry measure set.name: Carpentry measure set
Carpentry measure set.description: A retractable beam rule, a marking gauge, a small square, and a block plane in a belt pouch. Sufficient for measuring, marking, and fitting structural timber and finish carpentry. Workshop machinery is a separate matter. Replace blades when they stop cutting cleanly. [ Standard | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Chemistry field testing kit.name: Chemistry field testing kit
Chemistry field testing kit.description: Reagent strips, a mixing tray, a portable burner, and a reference booklet for common compound identification and basic reactions. Supports field-level analysis and sample preparation. Full synthesis requires laboratory conditions and appropriate licensing. Handle reagents with care. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Cultivation hand-tool set.name: Cultivation hand-tool set
Cultivation hand-tool set.description: A trowel, pruning shears, a soil probe, and seed-spacing guides for small-scale growing. Suitable for garden plots, balcony containers, and greenhouse starts. Larger-scale agricultural work requires field equipment. Clean soil from blades between plantings to prevent disease transfer. [ Basic | Common | Helvyra suppliers ]

Misdirection props.name: Misdirection props
Misdirection props.description: A small case of common distraction items: flash-paper sheets, noise makers, a mirror card, and a pocket smoke capsule. Used by stage performers, street entertainers, and people whose work occasionally requires not being the center of attention. Civilian items only; no military-grade countermeasures. [ Standard | Uncommon | Helvyra suppliers ]

Drone coordination relay.name: Drone coordination relay
Drone coordination relay.description: A portable signal relay that extends command range and improves response latency for small civilian drone swarms. Supports up to four units in standard atmospheric conditions. Requires compatible drone hardware. Range and reliability degrade in dense urban environments and during storm activity. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Drone piloting controller.name: Drone piloting controller
Drone piloting controller.description: A handheld flight controller with haptic feedback and a heads-up projection for single-drone operation. Compatible with standard Contair civilian drone platforms. Manual override and return-to-base functions included. Does not grant access to restricted airspace or military drone networks. [ Standard | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Ecology survey notebook.name: Ecology survey notebook
Ecology survey notebook.description: A weather-resistant field notebook with pre-printed survey grids, species tally sheets, and habitat classification references for Nexaran ecosystems. Includes a hand magnifier and a water-testing strip pouch. Data collection, not data analysis; the laboratory comes later. [ Standard | Common | Solvraxis Academy supply ]

Portable wiring kit.name: Portable wiring kit
Portable wiring kit.description: Wire strippers, crimping tools, a continuity tester, and a selection of common connectors and insulation tape in a folding case. Covers residential and light commercial electrical work. High-voltage and industrial systems require specialized equipment and certification. [ Standard | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Fermentation monitoring kit.name: Fermentation monitoring kit
Fermentation monitoring kit.description: A hydrometer, pH strips, temperature probes, and a culture-assessment guide for monitoring active fermentation processes. Covers brewing, pickling, and other controlled biological conversion. The kit reads what is happening; it does not fix a batch that has already turned. [ Standard | Uncommon | Helvyra suppliers ]

Firecraft starter set.name: Firecraft starter set
Firecraft starter set.description: A fire steel, tinder pouch, wind guard, and a compact bellows for starting and maintaining fires in field conditions. Includes a fuel-type reference card for common Nexaran environments. Technique and dry material still required. [ Basic | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Fishing tackle set.name: Fishing tackle set
Fishing tackle set.description: A compact reel, line, hooks, sinkers, and a selection of lures suited to freshwater species common in Nexaran rivers and reservoirs. Includes a basic species-identification card. Saltwater and deep-water fishing require different equipment. Inspect line for fraying before each use. [ Standard | Common | Helvyra suppliers ]

Foraging field guide.name: Foraging field guide
Foraging field guide.description: A weather-resistant reference with illustrations, habitat notes, and toxicity warnings for edible and medicinal plants found across major Nexaran biomes. Covers seasonal availability and common look-alikes. The guide identifies; the forager decides. [ Standard | Common | Solvraxis Academy supply ]

Geology sampling hammer.name: Geology sampling hammer
Geology sampling hammer.description: A pointed-tip rock hammer, a chisel set, sample bags, and a hardness-testing kit for mineral identification and geological survey work. Suitable for surface collection and outcrop sampling. Subsurface extraction requires heavy equipment. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Hunting field kit.name: Hunting field kit
Hunting field kit.description: Scent-masking compounds, game calls, a compact blind sheet, and a field-dressing roll for hunting common Nexaran game species. Legal hunting requires appropriate permits in most jurisdictions. Dustfall and frontier territories are less particular. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Investigation case notes.name: Investigation case notes
Investigation case notes.description: A structured case-management notebook with evidence log templates, witness interview forms, timeline construction guides, and chain-of-custody documentation. Used by investigators, insurance assessors, and private inquiry agents. Organization aids investigation; it does not grant authority. [ Standard | Uncommon | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Machining caliper set.name: Machining caliper set
Machining caliper set.description: Precision calipers, a micrometer, thread gauges, and a surface-finish comparator in a padded case. Supports measurement and quality verification for machined parts. Actual machining requires shop equipment. Calibrate against known references periodically. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Mediation reference cards.name: Mediation reference cards
Mediation reference cards.description: A deck of structured mediation process cards: opening frameworks, de-escalation sequences, agreement templates, and cultural protocol reminders for inter-House and inter-city disputes. A tool for the mediator, not a substitute for impartiality. [ Standard | Uncommon | Corsair trade goods ]

Networking contact ledger.name: Networking contact ledger
Networking contact ledger.description: A secured personal ledger with indexed contact pages, meeting-note templates, and a follow-up scheduling system. Used by trade representatives, political aides, and anyone whose work depends on remembering who said what and when. The ledger records; the relationships are earned elsewhere. [ Standard | Common | Corsair trade goods ]

Nursing supply pouch.name: Nursing supply pouch
Nursing supply pouch.description: A hip-mounted pouch containing patient-monitoring tools, medication administration supplies, wound-dressing materials, and species-specific vital-sign reference cards. Standard issue for ward nurses and home-care providers. Restocking is the practitioner's responsibility. [ Standard | Common | Myralis clinic supply ]

Persuasion briefing folio.name: Persuasion briefing folio
Persuasion briefing folio.description: A structured preparation folio with argument-mapping templates, objection-anticipation worksheets, and audience-analysis frameworks. Used by negotiators, advocates, and trade representatives preparing for high-stakes conversations. Preparation improves odds; it does not guarantee outcomes. [ Standard | Uncommon | Corsair trade goods ]

Pharmacology reference kit.name: Pharmacology reference kit
Pharmacology reference kit.description: A dosage-calculation reference, interaction-checking cards, and sample-identification tools for common Nexaran pharmaceuticals. Supports dispensing verification and patient counseling. Prescribing authority requires separate licensure. Handle controlled substances per local regulations. [ Standard | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Portable camera rig.name: Portable camera rig
Portable camera rig.description: A compact imaging device with interchangeable lens mounts, a stabilization grip, and a light-metering display. Covers still and short-sequence capture in standard lighting conditions. Processing and printing require separate facilities. Protect the lens from impact and atmospheric particulates. [ Standard | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Search and recovery kit.name: Search and recovery kit
Search and recovery kit.description: A grid-marking tape set, a probe rod, a compact mirror-on-stick, and a systematic search-pattern reference card. Supports area searches for lost objects, missing persons, and evidence recovery. Covers method; what you find depends on what is there. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Sheltercraft supply roll.name: Sheltercraft supply roll
Sheltercraft supply roll.description: A compact bundle of tarp material, cordage, stakes, and a pole-lashing guide for constructing temporary field shelters. Covers basic lean-tos, wind breaks, and rain covers. Permanent construction requires carpentry. Test knots under load before relying on them. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Sleight-of-hand practice set.name: Sleight-of-hand practice set
Sleight-of-hand practice set.description: Weighted practice coins, card decks with training marks, a lockpick tutor, and a dexterity drill guide. Standard training equipment for stage performers, security consultants, and anyone who needs to know how small objects move between hands. Civilian use only. [ Standard | Uncommon | Helvyra suppliers ]

Structural design templates.name: Structural design templates
Structural design templates.description: Drafting templates, a load-calculation slide rule, and a material-properties reference booklet for structural planning and assessment. Covers beam sizing, foundation requirements, and basic stress analysis. Full engineering sign-off requires professional certification. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Surgery instrument case.name: Surgery instrument case
Surgery instrument case.description: A sterilization-ready case containing scalpels, hemostats, retractors, and suturing supplies for field and clinic surgical procedures. Species-specific instrument profiles available. Surgical authority requires training, licensure, and a patient. Sterilize before and after every use. [ Standard | Rare | Myralis clinic supply ]

Surveying measure chain.name: Surveying measure chain
Surveying measure chain.description: A calibrated measuring chain, sighting poles, a clinometer, and a recording slate for land survey and boundary verification. Covers distance, elevation, and angle measurement in field conditions. Official survey records require registered surveyor attestation. [ Standard | Uncommon | Corsair trade goods ]

Teaching preparation kit.name: Teaching preparation kit
Teaching preparation kit.description: Lesson-planning templates, student-assessment forms, a small demonstration aid set, and a classroom-management reference. Used by instructors, tutors, and training supervisors across academic and trade contexts. Organizing instruction is a skill; delivering it is another. [ Standard | Common | Solvraxis Academy supply ]

Tracking field markers.name: Tracking field markers
Tracking field markers.description: Scent-neutral marker flags, a track-casting kit, a distance pacer, and a gait-analysis reference for following trails and identifying movement patterns. Used by hunters, search teams, and security patrols. Reading a trail requires training; the kit provides tools, not answers. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Trapping snare components.name: Trapping snare components
Trapping snare components.description: Wire snares, trigger mechanisms, bait containers, and a trap-placement guide for humane capture of common Nexaran game and pest species. Legal trapping requires permits in most jurisdictions; frontier territories enforce only what someone is willing to enforce. Check traps regularly. [ Standard | Common | Dustfall market ]

Weather observation instruments.name: Weather observation instruments
Weather observation instruments.description: A portable barometer, wind-speed gauge, humidity indicator, and a cloud-classification reference card. Supports short-term weather prediction based on local observation. Long-range forecasting requires network data. Useful for pilots, farmers, and anyone whose plans depend on what the sky intends. [ Standard | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Welding hand unit.name: Welding hand unit
Welding hand unit.description: A compact plasma-arc welding tool with a fuel cartridge, an auto-darkening lens, and common filler rods for field joining of standard Nexaran alloys. Covers repair welds and light fabrication. Structural work requires full shop equipment and certification. Ventilate the work area. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Robotics diagnostic probe.name: Robotics diagnostic probe
Robotics diagnostic probe.description: A multi-head diagnostic probe, a servo-testing jig, and a sensor-calibration reference for civilian robotics maintenance and troubleshooting. Compatible with standard Contair automation platforms. Reprogramming and structural modification require workshop access. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Piloting checklist binder.name: Piloting checklist binder
Piloting checklist binder.description: Pre-flight, in-flight, and emergency checklists for common Nexaran aircraft types, bound in a knee-board format with a navigation-aid pocket. Covers standard civilian airframes. Military and experimental craft have their own documentation. The checklist keeps you honest; the aircraft keeps you airborne. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Corsair boarding cutlass.name: Corsair boarding cutlass
Corsair boarding cutlass.description: A short, heavy-bladed sword favored by Corsair barge crews and waypoint security. The curved blade and weighted guard suit confined spaces and quick, decisive cuts. Maintained by Helvyra sword schools as a practical sidearm, not a dueling weapon. [ Standard | Common | Corsair trade goods ]

Contair shock baton.name: Contair shock baton
Contair shock baton.description: A collapsible alloy baton with an integrated capacitor discharge system. Delivers a short-range electrical pulse on contact. Standard security equipment in Vexorath and licensed for civilian self-defense in most cities. Recharge after five discharges. Quilrath regulates ownership by civic standing. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Genesis arena mace.name: Genesis arena mace
Genesis arena mace.description: A flanged striking weapon approved for Bracket competition in Korrvane. Weighted head, shock-absorbing grip, and a balance profile that rewards committed swings over tentative jabs. Tournament inspectors check head integrity before each bout. Popular among fighters who prefer decisiveness to finesse. [ Standard | Common | Korrvane Arena supply ]

Dustfall pipe rifle.name: Dustfall pipe rifle
Dustfall pipe rifle.description: A frontier-manufactured single-shot rifle assembled from salvaged pipe stock and machined breech components. Accuracy varies with build quality. Common in Dustfall where factory weapons are expensive and ammunition formats are inconsistent. Inspect bore and breech seal before every firing session. Damage type: heavy-ballistic (large caliber; pierces Starian skin). [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Volen forge hammer.name: Volen forge hammer
Volen forge hammer.description: A short-handled striking hammer from the Red Forges of Ignivex, originally a smithing tool but carried as a personal weapon by forge workers and Volen militia. The thermal-hardened head survives impacts that would crack commercial steel. Heavier than it looks. [ Standard | Common | Ignivex Red Forges ]

Republic patrol carbine.name: Republic patrol carbine
Republic patrol carbine.description: A compact plasma carbine issued to Republic civic patrol units in Relstaris. Shorter range and lower output than military rifles, optimized for urban engagement distances and reduced collateral risk. Civilian acquisition requires registration and background clearance. Damage type: plasma (wounds Starians). [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Republic armory surplus ]

Twin fighting daggers.name: Twin fighting daggers
Twin fighting daggers.description: A matched pair of short fighting blades with reverse grips and finger guards, carried in a cross-draw sheath. Common in Helvyra's sword schools as a secondary weapon discipline. The paired style requires dedicated training; one dagger alone is just a knife with pretensions. [ Standard | Common | Helvyra suppliers ]

Dravon compliance rod.name: Dravon compliance rod
Dravon compliance rod.description: A rigid striking rod with a textured grip and a weighted striking head, standard issue to Dravon enforcement personnel in Quilrath. Designed to hurt without killing, though the distinction is academic at sufficient force. Civilian possession outside Quilrath is legal but conspicuous. [ Restricted | Uncommon | Quilrath state stores ]

Corsair road jacket.name: Corsair road jacket
Corsair road jacket.description: A heavy-duty travel jacket with reinforced panels at the shoulders, elbows, and back. Standard wear for waypoint couriers and Corsair road crews. Protects against road rash, thrown debris, and the occasional disagreement. Does not substitute for combat armor. [ Standard | Common | Corsair trade goods ]

Contair workshop apron armor.name: Contair workshop apron armor
Contair workshop apron armor.description: A torso-covering apron of layered composite weave originally designed for workshop safety in Vexorath. Resists sparks, chemical splashes, and light impacts. Field workers discovered it also handles frontier hazards tolerably well. Not designed for ballistic threats. [ Standard | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Dustfall scrap-plate helm.name: Dustfall scrap-plate helm
Dustfall scrap-plate helm.description: A frontier helmet assembled from salvaged armor plate, fitted with padding and a chinstrap by whatever competent hands were available. Protection varies with quality of the source material and the skill of the fitter. Common in Dustfall and along the southern corridor. Inspect welds before trusting your skull to them. [ Frontier | Uncommon | Refit Row salvage ]

Genesis leg wraps.name: Genesis leg wraps
Genesis leg wraps.description: Layered impact-resistant wraps covering shin, knee, and thigh, standard Arena equipment in Korrvane. Flexible enough for full range of motion during competition. Inspectors verify padding density and structural integrity before each Bracket bout. Also worn by construction workers in high-fall-risk environments. [ Standard | Common | Korrvane Arena supply ]

Volen heat-resistant gauntlets.name: Volen heat-resistant gauntlets
Volen heat-resistant gauntlets.description: Heavy-duty gauntlets with thermal shielding rated for sustained forge work in Ignivex's Red Forges. Multi-layered composite palms resist heat transfer and abrasion. Dexterity is compromised; fine manipulation requires lighter gloves. Replace insulation liner when it compresses. [ Reinforced | Common | Ignivex Red Forges ]

Republic tactical vest.name: Republic tactical vest
Republic tactical vest.description: A modular torso vest with removable ballistic panels and load-bearing attachment points, issued to Republic civic patrol and security contractors in Relstaris. Configurable for threat profile and operational load. Civilian surplus models have the command-net interface removed. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Republic armory surplus ]

Reinforced tread greaves.name: Reinforced tread greaves
Reinforced tread greaves.description: Ankle-to-calf armored boots with composite shin plates and tread soles designed for rough terrain. Common among frontier contractors, salvage crews, and anyone whose work puts them on unstable surfaces. The armor protects the lower leg; the tread keeps the wearer upright. [ Reinforced | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Castro guardian helm.name: Castro guardian helm
Castro guardian helm.description: A full-coverage protective helmet with integrated visor and communications mount, standard issue for Castro civic guardians in Solvraxis. Designed for de-escalation visibility as much as protection: the wearer is clearly identifiable as a guardian. Civilian replicas exist but lack comms integration. [ Reinforced | Uncommon | Castro civic supply ]

Ration pack.name: Ration pack
Ration pack.description: A sealed meal packet containing calorie-dense food, a water-purification tablet, and a heating element. Covers one full meal for a standard Starian or Human adult. Flavor is functional, not memorable. Common in frontier supply, military surplus, and emergency preparedness kits. Check date codes; expired heating elements can fail or ignite unexpectedly. [ Basic | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Signal flare canister.name: Signal flare canister
Signal flare canister.description: A single-use aerial signal flare in a sealed launch tube. Produces a bright visible-spectrum burst at altitude, visible for several kilometers in clear conditions. Standard distress signaling in frontier and maritime contexts. Store away from heat. Not a weapon, though it can start fires if used recklessly. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Detox compound.name: Detox compound
Detox compound.description: A single-dose broad-spectrum detoxification agent in a sealed ampoule. Reduces the severity of common ingested and contact toxins when administered within a reasonable window. Not a cure, not instant, and not effective against all substances. Species-specific formulations exist; using the wrong one is counterproductive. [ Standard | Uncommon | Myralis clinic supply ]

Adhesive patch kit.name: Adhesive patch kit
Adhesive patch kit.description: A pack of industrial-strength adhesive patches, sealant strips, and quick-bonding compound for emergency repair of equipment, containers, and structural surfaces. One kit covers several small repairs or one substantial patch job. The bond is strong but temporary; proper repair should follow. [ Basic | Common | Contair manufacturing ]

Stimulant tabs.name: Stimulant tabs
Stimulant tabs.description: A blister pack of mild legal stimulant tablets that reduce fatigue symptoms for several hours. Common among shift workers, long-haul couriers, and students during examination periods. Not a substitute for actual rest; the debt accumulates. Exceeding recommended dosage produces diminishing returns and increasing side effects. [ Basic | Common | Relstaris Grand Market ]

Cartographer's wrist display.name: Cartographer's wrist display
Cartographer's wrist display.description: A wrist-mounted terrain-mapping display that overlays stored cartographic data on the wearer's current position. Supports waypoint marking and distance estimation. Useful for surveyors, scouts, and anyone navigating unfamiliar terrain. Data quality depends on the maps loaded; unmapped territory stays unmapped. [ Standard | Uncommon | Contair manufacturing ]

Corsair trade brace.name: Corsair trade brace
Corsair trade brace.description: A leather wrist brace embossed with Corsair trade-route marks, worn by licensed merchants and freight handlers as informal identification. Some versions incorporate a small abacus rail. Recognized at waypoints and trade arcades across Helvyra and the Longreach corridor. [ Standard | Common | Corsair trade goods ]

Instructor's whistle chain.name: Instructor's whistle chain
Instructor's whistle chain.description: A neck-chain-mounted signal whistle and timing device used by academy instructors, drill supervisors, and training coordinators. The whistle carries across training grounds; the timer keeps sessions honest. Simple, durable, and universally understood. [ Basic | Common | Solvraxis Academy supply ]

Frontier spotter's eyepiece.name: Frontier spotter's eyepiece
Frontier spotter's eyepiece.description: A monocular magnification eyepiece with a head-mount clip, used by scouts, hunters, and frontier lookouts for long-range observation. Adjustable focus and a basic rangefinding reticle. One eye magnified, one eye ambient; takes practice to use without headaches. [ Standard | Common | Grit and Supply ]

Vexorath engineer's badge.name: Vexorath engineer's badge
Vexorath engineer's badge.description: A clip-on identification badge issued to certified systems engineers in Vexorath. Incorporates a micro-display showing current system alerts and maintenance-queue status. Recognized by Contair facilities for workshop access. Not transferable; the badge verifies the wearer, not the holder. [ Standard | Uncommon | Vexorath Exchange ]

Zencadian continuity exoframe.name: Zencadian continuity exoframe
Zencadian continuity exoframe.description: A powered augmentation frame manufactured to Vigil continuity engineering standards — resonance-compatible alloy lattice, distributed micro-actuators, and triple-redundant systems throughout. Moves like a second skin; responds faster than the wearer expects. Amplifies strength and absorbs impact well beyond what the frame's low weight suggests. Requires Zencadian-certified power cores and workshop access for maintenance. [ Vigil Engineering | Rare | Zencadian-fitted ]

Zencadian integrated flight system.name: Zencadian integrated flight system
Zencadian integrated flight system.description: A flight module integrated into the Zencadian exoframe architecture — distributed thrust points embedded in the frame's lattice rather than a bolted-on pack. Provides the smoothest non-Starian aerial movement available: responsive directional control, quiet operation, and sustained flight duration measured in hours rather than minutes. Still not Starian flight — louder, less maneuverable, power-dependent — but the closest any technology comes. Requires a compatible Zencadian exoframe. [ Vigil Engineering | Rare | Zencadian-fitted ]

Terra coalition exoframe.name: Terra coalition exoframe
Terra coalition exoframe.description: A powered augmentation frame built to Terra coalition interface standard — hydraulic-assist joints, composite plating, and standardized power cells that swap between manufacturers. Heavier and louder than Zencadian equivalents, but field-serviceable with standard tools and replacement parts available through any Accord supply chain. Amplifies strength and provides solid impact protection. Practical, not elegant. [ Terra Coalition Standard | Uncommon | Human-fitted ]

Terra thrust pack.name: Terra thrust pack
Terra thrust pack.description: A bolt-on jetpack unit built to Terra coalition standard — twin directional thrusters, fuel cell with a burn time measured in minutes of sustained flight, and straightforward manual controls. Provides tactical aerial repositioning: roof-to-roof jumps, controlled descent from height, short powered climbs. Not sustained flight. Loud, visible, and the fuel gauge is always relevant. Field-swappable fuel cells. [ Terra Coalition Standard | Uncommon | Human-fitted ]

Kharai clan-workshop exoframe.name: Kharai clan-workshop exoframe
Kharai clan-workshop exoframe.description: A powered augmentation frame from a Kharai clan workshop — noise-dampened actuators, low-profile geometry preserving the Kharai center of gravity, and fitted construction that respects auditory sensitivity. Amplifies strength without producing the mechanical drone that makes other species' frames unbearable for Kharai hearing. Each frame is individually fitted; replacement parts require the originating workshop or compatible Kharai specifications. [ Kharai Clan-Workshop | Uncommon | Kharai-fitted ]

Kharai dorsal thruster module.name: Kharai dorsal thruster module
Kharai dorsal thruster module.description: A compact dorsal thrust unit designed for Kharai movement patterns — powerful vertical boost for high leaps and controlled descent, with burst lateral thrust for mid-air repositioning. Matches the Kharai instinct to move in sharp bursts rather than sustained glides. Noise-dampened exhaust. Limited fuel; each burst draws from a shared reserve. [ Kharai Clan-Workshop | Uncommon | Kharai-fitted ]

Rivani craft-fellowship exoframe.name: Rivani craft-fellowship exoframe
Rivani craft-fellowship exoframe.description: A powered augmentation frame from a Rivani craft-fellowship — the lightest non-Zencadian design, built for Rivani proportions with actuators concentrated in the limbs and shoulders. Amplifies reach and grip strength rather than raw mass. Preserves the manual dexterity Rivani rely on for fine work. Each unit is a signed piece — the maker's reputation is attached. Maintenance requires fellowship-standard tooling. [ Rivani Craft-Fellowship | Uncommon | Rivani-fitted ]

Rivani paired thrust unit.name: Rivani paired thrust unit
Rivani paired thrust unit.description: Paired lateral thrust modules sized for Rivani proportions — compact, balanced, and responsive to light-body aerodynamics. Provides short aerial hops, controlled glide descent, and enough sustained thrust for brief tactical repositioning. The Rivani's lower mass means better thrust-to-weight than heavier species get from similar power. Craft-fellowship construction; consistent quality. [ Rivani Craft-Fellowship | Uncommon | Rivani-fitted ]

Olyth adaptive exoframe.name: Olyth adaptive exoframe
Olyth adaptive exoframe.description: A powered augmentation frame designed for Olyth reshaping biology — segmented panels connected by flexible articulation bands that expand, contract and reposition as the wearer's body shifts. The frame's geometry is semi-fluid: it cannot reshape itself, but accommodates the wearer's reshaping within a designed range. The most mechanically complex non-Zencadian exoframe. Amplifies strength across multiple body configurations. Maintenance requires understanding of both the frame and the wearer's reshaping patterns. [ Olyth Adaptive Fabrication | Uncommon | Olyth-fitted ]

Olyth distributed thrust array.name: Olyth distributed thrust array
Olyth distributed thrust array.description: Distributed thrust points across the exoframe's surface rather than a single pack — the system compensates automatically for the Olyth wearer's shifting center of mass during reshaping. Provides controlled aerial movement, vertical repositioning, and assisted descent. Less efficient per-thruster than a concentrated pack, but the only flight module that works with a body that changes shape mid-flight. [ Olyth Adaptive Fabrication | Uncommon | Olyth-fitted ]

Terra coalition vest.name: Terra coalition vest
Terra coalition vest.description: A light torso protector built to Terra coalition interface standard — composite weave panels, standard closures, and a fit pattern common across all six Accords. Basic impact protection for civilian fieldwork, entry-level security details, and general preparedness. Serviceable with standard parts. Not powered; not impressive. [ Terra Coalition Standard | Common | Human-fitted ]

Kharai noise-dampened vest.name: Kharai noise-dampened vest
Kharai noise-dampened vest.description: A fitted torso protector designed for Kharai physiology — noise-dampened fasteners, low-profile panel geometry that preserves the Kharai center of gravity, and padding that absorbs impact without producing the sharp clatter that louder armor creates. Standard protection from a clan workshop; each piece is fitted to order. [ Kharai Clan-Workshop | Common | Kharai-fitted ]

Zencadian systems vest.name: Zencadian systems vest
Zencadian systems vest.description: A light torso protector from a Vigil civic workshop — alloy-composite panels over a fitted underlayer, with integrated diagnostic contacts along the spine. Designed for Zencadian proportions: tall, narrow-framed, with long arms that need articulation clearance at the shoulders. Reliable protection and quiet mechanical status. [ Vigil Civic Workshop | Common | Zencadian-fitted ]

Personal sidearm.name: Personal sidearm
Personal sidearm.description: A basic service sidearm of the bearer's own people's make: a Starian plasma pattern, a Terran coalition-standard pistol, a Kharai clan-workshop piece with a dampened report, a compact Rivani fellowship-built pistol, an Olyth sealed-casing pattern, a Zencadian sidearm with layered safeties, or an Elyri resonance-safe pattern. Reliable, unremarkable and meant for self-defence; every species' makers build their own. It fires charges from the matching Sidearm charge pack; spent charges are replaced, not recharged in the field. Surrendered to bonded storage on entering Solvraxis. Damage type follows the make: a Starian pattern fires plasma; a Terran or other offworld small-caliber pistol is ballistic, lethal to most species but unable to pierce Starian skin. [ Basic | Common | Bearer's own makers ]

Sidearm charge pack.name: Sidearm charge pack
Sidearm charge pack.description: A sealed pack of charges made for the bearer's own-pattern Personal sidearm by the same makers. Each charge is self-contained and finite; spent charges are waste, not rechargeable, and a pack does not refill. Replacements cost Credits and are easiest to find where the bearer's own people trade. [ Basic | Common | Bearer's own makers ]

Fellowship short blade.name: Fellowship short blade
Fellowship short blade.description: A compact short blade made by a Rivani craft-fellowship, balanced for fine hands and close work, with the maker's vouch mark on the tang. Light, precise and quick to recover; it gives away reach to any longer weapon. Surrendered to bonded storage on entering Solvraxis. [ Basic | Common | Rivani fellowship make ]

Lantern fencing blade.name: Lantern fencing blade
Lantern fencing blade.description: A light Terran duelling blade from the Lantern Sphere, made for formal fencing, with a small blank inscription plate set into the guard for the wearer's own prepared wards. It carries no working of its own; anything inscribed on it is paid for by its maker in vitality and fades in a thin field. Surrendered to bonded storage on entering Solvraxis. [ Basic | Common | Lantern Sphere make ]
